name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SMB Customer Success Manager | Adoption, Retention, Renewals & Expansion
summary: Customer success manager for SMB books who owns the full journey: onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion. Retained all but one of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye (~94%), including partners serving home-services businesses, by monitoring utilization and stepping in before adoption gaps became churn. Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while onboarding 25+ SMB clients a month at Wix. Builds marketing automation for electricians, plumbers, and HVAC businesses today, so he knows how the trades buy, communicate, and lose business to missed calls.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Build marketing-automation workflows for home-services businesses (electrical, plumbing, HVAC), working directly with owners on how they capture, answer, and follow up with customers.
Built outreach campaigns targeting service and trade businesses losing work to missed calls and slow follow-up, plus an audit workflow that enrolled 180+ businesses.
Own the client relationship from onboarding through ongoing delivery, running discovery to set goals and success metrics for each engagement.
Built automated re-engagement and reactivation workflows that bring inactive customers back, part of a 20+ workflow lifecycle system.
Expand scope with existing clients, identifying complementary services and writing the proposals and statements of work to close them.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Ran quarterly business reviews for ~3 multi-stakeholder accounts at $20K+/month ad spend each, reporting ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs.
Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed a book of 15-20 reseller partners with deal sizes of ~$10K-$45K, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Onboarded partners and their end customers, guiding complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing automation tools.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to find adoption gaps and intervene before they turned into churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics across health, home services, and retail verticals, sustaining 50+ partner activities a day.
Brought structured voice-of-customer feedback to Product and Engineering, linking field signals to roadmap decisions.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each, several exceeding $25K, for roughly $130K+ in total bookings.
Ran client accounts end to end, covering execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, and led the sales team.

bullets: Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while onboarding and launching 25+ clients per month.
Set up third-party shipping integrations for e-commerce clients launching online storefronts alongside their physical retail locations.
Managed a high-value account portfolio, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led multiple onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, running weekly training sessions and 1:1 coaching.
Drove team initiatives for a new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, including sales training for tenured account executives.

Averaged ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue, consistently into accelerator tiers.
Wrote proposals and statements of work for agencies and professional-services firms across a global client base, building sequenced implementation plans for onboarding.

bullets: Ran full-cycle SaaS sales to SMBs, making up to 150 dials/day and closing up to 10 deals/month.
